description: The plot illustrates the similarity across different layers, comparing four distinct combinations represented by different colored lines. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22 in intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45 in intervals of 0.05. The red line, representing "en&en", starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.27 at layer 6, and then ends at about 0.43 at layer 22, with a notable decline to around 0.15 between layers 6 and 8. The blue line, representing "en&es", begins at roughly 0.03, reaches a peak of approximately 0.25 at layer 6, and concludes at about 0.29 at layer 22. The green line, representing "en&el", starts at around 0.02, peaks at approximately 0.14 at layer 6, and ends at about 0.26 at layer 22. The purple line, representing "en&bn", begins at roughly 0.02, reaches a peak of approximately 0.14 at layer 6, and concludes at about 0.28 at layer 22. All lines generally follow a similar trend, with an initial increase, a peak around layer 6, a subsequent decline, and a final increase towards layer 22.
